logic.setup: At completed UTC daily close t, when flat and no setup is pending, arm a failed-breakdown setup only if close[t] is strictly below lower[t]=min(low[t-N:t]); the N prior completed daily bars exclude t. Store that exact lower level and expiry day index t+K.
logic.reclaim: On one of the next K completed daily closes after the breakdown day (inclusive of day t+K), if close[j] is strictly above the stored lower[t], enter long at the next UTC day 00:01 1-minute bar open. A reclaim on breakdown day itself is not allowed. While pending, ignore any subsequent new lows and retain the first broken level. If K days pass without reclaim, disarm after the expiry day close; a new breakdown may arm from the following closed day.
logic.hold_exit: Hold exactly H=5 elapsed UTC daily intervals from virtual entry timestamp; exit at the 00:01 UTC minute open after five full closed daily bars. Ignore all new breakdown/reclaim signals while holding and on the exit event day; setup processing resumes the next UTC daily decision. No stop, profit target or overlapping positions.
logic.sizing: One 2,000-USDT portfolio with separate BTC and ETH long-only cash sleeves; raw initial weights 0.50/0.50 (1,000 USDT each). Each signal uses its sleeve only; no cross-sleeve transfers/rebalancing, leverage, shorting or cash interest. Full available sleeve cash is allocated at entry; full units sold at exit.
logic.timing: Only fully closed UTC daily OHLC bars can arm, reclaim or exit. Daily close becomes available at next UTC 00:00; simulated order reference is the following 00:01 1-minute open, 60 seconds later. Warmup data may form the prior N-day levels, but there are no pre-OOS positions. OOS begins 2025-09-19 00:01 UTC and terminal liquidation is 2026-09-14 00:01 UTC.
logic.channel_extrema: Prior-low calculation excludes the compared day. Reclaim compares against the saved breakdown-day lower level, not a moving later channel.
